scope: manager lifecycle acceptance definitions, not execution evidence
fixtures: isolated OpenWrt guest, tmpfs target/source fixtures, real delivered helper and strict NUL argv oracle

scenarios.given: registered source and matching or changed filesystem UUID
scenarios.then: matching source preserves routes; changed UUID refuses binding before planner or media transfer

scenarios.given: planner failure or route tmp write/validation/rename/sync failure
scenarios.then: no actual media rsync; prior snapshot unchanged before rename; after rename sync failure retain visible snapshot and fail
same routes/view; one actual rsync without ignore-existing; partial remains recoverable

scenarios.given: registered library policy with unknown profile or changed date intent
scenarios.then: unsupported profile fails before shared writes; supported existing routes do not move

scenarios.given: source detach, broken view link, target detach or target read-only
scenarios.then: nonzero task, never completed; retain published routes

scenarios.given: INT/TERM during probe, namespace, planning, view or transfer
scenarios.then: sticky first signal; no subsequent helper/rsync launch; drain before view removal, source unmount, lock and lease release

scenarios.given: concurrent owners, service stopped, changed lease generation, manual or initialize argv
scenarios.then: one writer; stop exact five/six NUL slots and typed arguments; remove matches only canonical event add

scenarios.given: rsync zero but sync/summary/final target/status fails
scenarios.then: nonzero and not completed; report original failure

scenarios.given: nested/equal roots, marked ancestors or descendants, unknown nonempty date root, residual routes
scenarios.then: both entrances reject before shared writes; switching UCI to mirror does not erase date protections

scenarios.given: missing helper/module/rsync capability or truncated structured result
scenarios.then: failure before library/identity/route publication; no mirror fallback

scenarios.given: planning/transferring/finalizing, zero transfer or partial failure
scenarios.then: version1 strict task channel; planning unknown progress; only actual rsync stdout observed; white-list warning counts

scenarios.given: other source data exists and new source has no identity/routes/namespace
scenarios.then: publish full empty route tmp/validate/sync/rename/sync/anchor/cancel before existing identity bind; interruptions resume by state table

scenarios.given: identity without route, nonempty route without identity, empty route with formal/partial/replaced namespace
scenarios.then: refuse; no identity claim, candidate publication or media transfer

scenarios.given: date source lacks FieldBackup.conf or mirror source lacks it
scenarios.then: date source_not_initialized before any RW mount; mirror legacy RO/RW/RO preserved

scenarios.given: route rename succeeded and subsequent sync failed
scenarios.then: no transfer on failed publication; retain visible complete route; strict admission on retry

scenarios.given: manual quick/checksum, subsequent automatic add, invalid comparison
scenarios.then: four-argument manual snapshot only; automatic always quick; invalid rejected before writes; no comparison UCI option

scenarios.given: root initialize DEVNAME DEVPATH with full source snapshot
scenarios.then: same admission/owner/lease; PRIMARY new-card config only; existing card not overwritten; no rsync/alias/identity/route registration

scenarios.given: empty direct date root on ext4/f2fs or unsupported target filesystem
scenarios.then: FD9 and owner-locked private real case/Unicode/sameFS-rename probe; unsupported filesystem refused; no production bypass

scenarios.given: candidate snapshot and existing formal/partial/replaced files
scenarios.then: minimum space and conservative metadata-only cost estimate; no media hash/all-library du/second content comparer
